border.name: Border

borderstyle.name: BorderStyle

bringtotop.name: BringToTop

dragicon.name: DragIcon

enabled.name: Enabled

height.name: Height

originalsize.name: OriginalSize

pointer.name: Pointer

powertiptext.name: PowerTipText

tag.name: Tag

transparent.name: Transparent

visible.name: Visible

displayname.name: DisplayName

dwmessagetitle.name: DWMessageTitle
dwmessagetitle.description: Specifies the title of the message box for any runtime DataWindow errors encountered in the application. If you change the value of this property in script, the new value is recognized only for DataWindows created (or painted) after the new value is set.

freedblibraries.name: FreeDBLibraries
freedblibraries.description: Specifies whether you want PowerBuilder to free database interface libraries upon disconnecting from the database. The default is FALSE (PowerBuilder does not free the libraries upon disconnecting).

highdpimode.name: HighDPIMode
highdpimode.description: Specifies the DPI (Dots Per Inch) awareness mode.

microhelpdefault.name: MicroHelpDefault
microhelpdefault.description: Specifies the default text of the MicroHelp object (the MicroHelp text that displays when you initiate a PowerBuilder session). The default is Ready.

toolbarframetitle.name: ToolbarFrameTitle

toolbarusercontrol.name: ToolbarUserControl

calendaritalic.name: CalendarItalic
calendaritalic.description: Specifies whether the text in the calendar is italic. Values are: TRUE -- Text is italic. FALSE -- Text is not italic (default). For more information, see Italic. calendartextsize.name: CalendarTextSize

modified.description: Specifies whether the text in the control has been modified since it was opened or last saved. Modified is the control's "dirty" flag, indicating that the control is in an unsaved state. Values are: TRUE -- The control has been modified. FALSE -- The control has not been modified. When the first change is made to a newly opened or saved control, PowerBuilder sets the Modified property to true and triggers the Modified event.

pentip.name: PenTip
pentip.description: A drawing attribute that specifies whether the pen tip is round or rectangular. Values are: PenTipBall! -- The pen tip is round (default). PenTipRectangle! -- The pen tip is rectangular.

pointer.name: Pointer
pointer.description: Specifies the name of the stock pointer or the file containing the pointer used for the control.

recognitiontimer.name: RecognitionTimer
recognitiontimer.description: Specifies the time period in milliseconds between the last ink stroke and the start of text recognition. The default is 2000 (two seconds).

righttoleft.name: RightToLeft
righttoleft.description: Specifies that characters should be displayed in right-to-left order. The application must be running on an operating system that supports right-to-left display. Values are: TRUE -- Characters display in right-to-left order. FALSE -- Characters display in left-to-right order.

status.name: Status
status.description: A read-only property available at runtime that provides the current status of the control so that the user does not need to monitor the Stroke event. Values are CollectingInk!, RecognizingInk!, and Idle!.

taborder.name: TabOrder
taborder.description: Specifies the tab value of the control within the window (0 means the user cannot tab to the control).

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: Specifies the tag value assigned to the control.

text.name: Text
text.description: Specifies the text that displays in the control.

textcolor.name: TextColor
textcolor.description: Specifies the numeric value of the color used for text: -2 to 16,777,215.

textsize.name: TextSize
textsize.description: Specifies the size of the text in the control, in points. For backward compatibility, the size is stored as a negative number; for example, 10-point text size is stored as -10.

underline.name: Underline
underline.description: Specifies whether the text in the control is underlined. Values are: TRUE -- Text is underlined. FALSE -- Text is not underlined (default).

usemouseforinput.name: UseMouseForInput
usemouseforinput.description: Specifies whether the mouse can be used for input on a Tablet PC. Values are: TRUE -- The mouse can be used for input. FALSE -- The mouse cannot be used for input (default).

visible.name: Visible
visible.description: Specifies whether the control is visible. Values are: TRUE -- Control is visible (default). FALSE -- Control is not visible.

vscrollbar.name: VScrollBar
vscrollbar.description: Specifies whether a vertical scroll bar is displayed on the right of the control. Values are: TRUE -- Vertical scroll bar is displayed. FALSE -- Vertical scroll bar is not displayed.

weight.name: Weight
weight.description: Specifies the stroke weight of the text in the control; for example, 400 for normal (default) or 700 for bold.

width.name: Width
width.description: Specifies the width of the control, in PowerBuilder units.

x.name: X
x.description: Specifies the X position (the distance from the left edge of the window), in PowerBuilder units.

y.name: Y
y.description: Specifies the Y position (the distance from the top of the window), in PowerBuilder units.

autoerase.name: AutoErase
autoerase.description: Specifies whether the auto erase feature available on some styluses is turned on. Values are: TRUE -- AutoErase is turned on. FALSE -- AutoErase is turned off (default).

backcolor.name: BackColor
backcolor.description: Specifies the numeric value of the background color: -2 to 16,777,215. For more information about color, see the section called “RGB” in PowerScript Reference.

border.name: Border
border.description: Specifies whether the control has a border. Values are: TRUE -- Control has a border. FALSE -- Control does not have a border.

borderstyle.name: BorderStyle
borderstyle.description: Specifies the border style of the control. Values are: StyleBox! StyleLowered! StyleRaised! StyleShadowBox!

bringtotop.name: BringToTop
bringtotop.description: Specifies whether PowerBuilder moves the control to the top of the front-to-back order.

classdefinition.name: ClassDefinition
classdefinition.description: An object of type PowerObject containing information about the class definition of the object or control.

collectionmode.name: CollectionMode
collectionmode.description: Specifies whether ink only, gestures only, or ink and gestures are collected. Values are: GestureOnly! -- Only gestures are collected. InkOnly! -- Only ink is collected (default). InkAndGesture! -- Ink and gestures are collected.

dragauto.name: DragAuto
dragauto.description: Specifies whether PowerBuilder puts the control automatically into Drag mode. Values are: TRUE -- When the control is clicked, the control is automatically in Drag mode. FALSE -- When the control is clicked, the control is not automatically in Drag mode. You have to manually put the control into Drag mode by using the Drag function.

dragicon.name: DragIcon
dragicon.description: Specifies the name of the stock icon or the file containing the icon you want to display when the user drags the control (the ICO file). The default icon is a box the size of the control. When the user drags the control, the icon displays when the control is over an area in which the control can be dropped (a valid drop area). When the control is over an area that is not a valid drop area, the No-Drop icon displays.

dynamicrendering.name: DynamicRendering
dynamicrendering.description: Specifies whether the ink is rendered (displayed in the control) as it is drawn. The default is true.

editmode.name: EditMode
editmode.description: Specifies whether the editing mode of the control is set for drawing ink, editing ink, or deleting ink. Values are: InkPicDeleteMode! -- Ink is deleted. InkPicInkMode! -- Ink can be drawn (default). InkPicSelectMode! -- Ink is selected for editing.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Specifies whether the control is enabled (can be selected). Values are: TRUE -- Control can be clicked. FALSE -- Control cannot be clicked.

erasermode.name: EraserMode
erasermode.description: Specifies whether ink is removed by stroke or point. Values are: 0 -- Ink is removed by stroke (default). 1 -- Ink is removed by point.

eraserwidth.name: EraserWidth
eraserwidth.description: Specifies the width of the eraser pen tip in pixels. The default is 212 pixels.

height.name: Height
height.description: Specifies the height of the control, in PowerBuilder units.

highcontrastink.name: HighContrastInk
highcontrastink.description: Specifies whether ink is rendered in a single color when the system is in high contrast mode and draws the selection rectangle and handles in high contrast. Values are: TRUE -- Ink is rendered in a single color in high contrast mode (default). FALSE -- Ink is not rendered in a single color in high contrast mode.

ignorepressure.name: IgnorePressure
ignorepressure.description: A drawing attribute that specifies whether the drawn ink gets wider as the pressure of the pen tip on the tablet surface increases. Values are: TRUE -- Pressure from the pen tip is ignored. FALSE -- The width of the ink increases with the pressure of the pen tip (default).

inkantialiased.name: InkAntiAliased
inkantialiased.description: A drawing attribute that specifies whether the foreground and background colors along the edge of the drawn ink are blended (antialiased) to make the stroke smoother and sharper. Values are: TRUE -- The ink stroke appears smoother and sharper (default). FALSE -- The ink stroke is not antialiased.

inkcolor.name: InkColor
inkcolor.description: A drawing attribute that specifies the current ink color. The default color is black.

inkenabled.name: InkEnabled
inkenabled.description: Specifies whether the InkPicture control collects pen input. Values are: TRUE -- The control collects pen input (default). FALSE -- The control does not collect pen input and no pen-related events fire.

inkfilename.name: InkFileName
inkfilename.description: Specifies the name of the file that the ink was loaded from.

inkheight.name: InkHeight
inkheight.description: A drawing attribute that specifies the height of the side of the rectangular pen tip in pixels. The default is 1.

inktransparency.name: InkTransparency
inktransparency.description: A drawing attribute that specifies the transparency of drawn ink. The range of values is from 0 for totally opaque (the default) to 255 for totally transparent.

inkwidth.name: InkWidth
inkwidth.description: A drawing attribute that specifies the width of the pen in pixels. The default is 53. If the IgnorePressure property is not set, the actual width varies between .5 times the value of the Width property for minimum pressure and 1.5 times its value for maximum pressure.

marginx.name: MarginX
marginx.description: Specifies the x-axis margin around the control in PowerBuilder units. The default value is 0.

marginy.name: MarginY
marginy.description: Specifies the y-axis margin around the control in PowerBuilder units. The default value is 0.

pentip.name: PenTip
pentip.description: A drawing attribute that specifies whether the pen tip is round or rectangular. Values are: PenTipBall! -- The pen tip is round (default). PenTipRectangle! -- The pen tip is rectangular.

picturefilename.name: PictureFileName
picturefilename.description: Specifies the name of a file that contains the picture for the control. The default is an empty string. Supported formats are SVG, BMP, GIF, JPEG, PNG, and TIF.

picturesizemode.name: PictureSizeMode
picturesizemode.description: Specifies how the picture is displayed in the control. Values are: InkPicAutoSize! -- The control is resized to display the entire picture. InkPicCentered! -- The picture is centered in the control. InkPicNormal! -- The picture is displayed in the upper-left corner of the control and any part of the picture that does not fit in the control is clipped (default). InkPicStretched! -- The picture is stretched to fill the control.

pointer.name: Pointer
pointer.description: Specifies the name of the stock pointer or the file containing the pointer used for the control.

powertiptext.name: PowerTipText
powertiptext.description: Specifies a PowerTip for the control.

status.name: Status
status.description: Read-only property available at runtime that provides the current status of the control so that the user does not need to monitor the Stroke event. Values are CollectingInk! and Idle!.

taborder.name: TabOrder
taborder.description: Specifies the tab value of the control within the window (0 means the user cannot tab to the control.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: Specifies the tag value assigned to the control.

visible.name: Visible
visible.description: Specifies whether the control is visible. Values are: TRUE -- Control is visible (default). FALSE -- Control is not visible.

width.name: Width
width.description: Specifies the width of the control, in PowerBuilder units.

x.name: X
x.description: Specifies the X position (the distance from the left edge of the window), in PowerBuilder units.

y.name: Y
y.description: Specifies the Y position (the distance from the top of the window), in PowerBuilder units.

beginx.name: BeginX
beginx.description: Specifies the X position of one end of the line (the distance from the left edge of the window), in PowerBuilder units.

beginy.name: BeginY
beginy.description: Specifies the Y position of one end of the line (the distance from the top of the window), in PowerBuilder units.

classdefinition.name: ClassDefinition
classdefinition.description: An object of type PowerObject containing information about the class definition of the object or control.

endx.name: EndX
endx.description: Specifies the X position of the other end of the line (the distance from the left edge of the window), in PowerBuilder units.

endy.name: EndY
endy.description: Specifies the Y position of the other end of the line (the distance from the top of the window), in PowerBuilder units.

linecolor.name: LineColor
linecolor.description: Specifies the numeric value of the line color: -2 to 16,777,215. For more information about color, see the section called “RGB” in PowerScript Reference.

linestyle.name: LineStyle
linestyle.description: Specifies the style of the line. Values are: Continuous! Dash! DashDot! DashDotDot! Dot! Transparent!

linethickness.name: LineThickness
linethickness.description: Specifies the thickness of the line, in PowerBuilder units. If LineThickness is greater than one pixel (about three PowerBuilder units), the LineStyle is Continuous!.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: Specifies the tag value assigned to the control.

visible.name: Visible
visible.description: Specifies whether the control is visible. Values are: TRUE -- Control is visible. FALSE -- Control is not visible.

accelerator.name: Accelerator
accelerator.description: Specifies the ASCII value of the key you want to assign as the accelerator key for a control.

accessibledescription.name: AccessibleDescription
accessibledescription.description: A description of the control and/or its purpose for use by accessibility tools such as readers for visually impaired users.

accessiblename.name: AccessibleName
accessiblename.description: A label that briefly describes the control, such as the text in a button or the name of a menu item.

accessiblerole.name: AccessibleRole
accessiblerole.description: Describes what kind of user interface element the control is.

backcolor.name: BackColor
backcolor.description: Specifies the numeric value of the background color: -2 to 16,777,215. For more information about color, see the section called “RGB” in PowerScript Reference.

border.name: Border
border.description: Specifies whether the control has a border. Values are: TRUE -- Control has a border. FALSE -- Control does not have a border.

borderstyle.name: BorderStyle
borderstyle.description: Specifies the style of the border of the control. Values are: StyleBox! StyleLowered! StyleRaised! StyleShadowBox!

bringtotop.name: BringToTop
bringtotop.description: Specifies whether PowerBuilder moves the control to the top of the front-to-back order. Values are: TRUE -- Control moved to top. FALSE -- Control not moved to top.

classdefinition.name: ClassDefinition
classdefinition.description: An object of type PowerObject containing information about the class definition of the object or control.

disablenoscroll.name: DisableNoScroll
disablenoscroll.description: Specifies behavior of a scroll bar. Values are: TRUE -- The scroll bar is always visible but is disabled when all the items can be accessed without it. FALSE -- The scroll bar is displayed only if it is necessary (based on the number of items and the height of the list box).

dragauto.name: DragAuto
dragauto.description: Specifies whether PowerBuilder puts the control automatically into Drag mode. Values are: TRUE -- When the control is clicked, the control is automatically in Drag mode. FALSE -- When the control is clicked, the control is not automatically in Drag mode. You have to manually put the control into Drag mode by using the Drag function.

dragicon.name: DragIcon
dragicon.description: Specifies the name of the stock icon or the file containing the icon you want to display when the user drags the control (the ICO file). The default icon is a box the size of the control. When the user drags the control, the icon displays when the control is over an area in which the control can be dropped (a valid drop area). When the control is over an area that is not a valid drop area, the No-Drop icon displays.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Specifies whether the control is enabled (can be selected). Values are: TRUE -- Control can be selected. FALSE -- Control cannot be selected.

extendedselect.name: ExtendedSelect
extendedselect.description: Specifies whether users can select multiple items in the list box at one time. Values are: TRUE -- Users can select multiple items by clicking on an item and dragging the mouse up or down to select items; using Click or Shift+ Click to select a sequential group of items; or using Ctrl+ Click on multiple items. FALSE -- Users cannot select multiple items. Used with MultiSelect The MultiSelect property allows users to select multiple items in a list box by simply clicking on the items. If MultiSelect = true and ExtendedSelect = true, then the behavior of ExtendedSelect takes precedence.

facename.name: FaceName
facename.description: Specifies the name of the typeface in which the text of the control displays (for example, arial or courier).

fontcharset.name: FontCharSet
fontcharset.description: Specifies the font character set used for the text in the control. For a complete list of possible values, see the list of properties for the FontCharSet variable on the Enumerated tab page of the Browser.

fontfamily.name: FontFamily
fontfamily.description: Specifies the font family (type style) used for the text in the control. Values are: AnyFont! Decorative! Modern! Roman! Script! Swiss!

fontpitch.name: FontPitch
fontpitch.description: Specifies the pitch (spacing) of the font used for the text in the control. Values are: Default! Fixed! Variable!

height.name: Height
height.description: Specifies the height of the control, in PowerBuilder units.

hscrollbar.name: HScrollBar
hscrollbar.description: Specifies whether a horizontal scroll bar displays. Values are: TRUE -- Horizontal scroll bar displays. FALSE -- Horizontal scroll bar does not display.

italic.name: Italic
italic.description: Specifies whether the text in the control is italic. Values are: TRUE -- Text is italic. FALSE -- Text is not italic.

item[ ].name: Item[ ]
item[ ].description: Specifies the items in the control.

multiselect.name: MultiSelect
multiselect.description: Specifies whether users can select multiple items in the ListBox at one time. Values are: TRUE -- Users can select multiple items. FALSE -- Users cannot select multiple items. Used with ExtendedSelect The MultiSelect property allows users to select multiple items in a list box by simply clicking on the items. If MultiSelect = true and ExtendedSelect = true, then the behavior of ExtendedSelect takes precedence.

pointer.name: Pointer
pointer.description: Specifies the name of the stock pointer or the file containing the pointer used for the control.

righttoleft.name: RightToLeft
righttoleft.description: Specifies that characters should be displayed in right-to-left order. The application must be running on an operating system that supports right-to-left display. Values are: TRUE -- Characters display in right-to-left order. FALSE -- Characters display in left-to-right order.

sorted.name: Sorted
sorted.description: Specifies whether the items in the ListBox are sorted. Values are: TRUE -- Items are sorted. FALSE -- Items are not sorted.

taborder.name: TabOrder
taborder.description: Specifies the tab value of the control (0 means the user cannot tab to the control).

tabstop[ ].name: TabStop[ ]
tabstop[ ].description: Specifies the positions of the tab stops in the ListBox. The tab stops are in character positions, and the tab stop delimiter is a space. If you assign a value to only the first tab stop, TabStop[1], the tab stops are equally spaced using the number of character positions specified for the first tab stop. If more than one tab stop is entered, tab stops are located in the positions specified. You can define 16 tab stops in the control; the default array is TabStop[8], with a tab stop every eight character positions.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: Specifies the tag value assigned to the control.

textcolor.name: TextColor
textcolor.description: Specifies the numeric value of the color used for text: -2 to 16,777,215. For more information about color, see the section called “RGB” in PowerScript Reference.

textsize.name: TextSize
textsize.description: Specifies the size of the text in the control, in points. For backward compatibility, the size is stored as a negative number; for example, 10-point text size is stored as -10.

underline.name: Underline
underline.description: Specifies whether the text in the control is underlined. Values are: TRUE -- Text is underlined. FALSE -- Text is not underlined.

visible.name: Visible

vscrollbar.name: VScrollBar

width.description: Specifies the width of the control, in PowerBuilder units.

y.name: Y
y.description: Specifies the Y position (the distance from the top of the window), in PowerBuilder units.

accelerator.description: Specifies the ASCII value of the accelerator key assigned for the control.

accessibledescription.description: A description of the control and/or its purpose for use by accessibility tools such as readers for visually impaired users.

accessiblename.name: AccessibleName
accessiblename.description: A label that briefly describes the control, such as the text in a button or the name of a menu item.

accessiblerole.name: AccessibleRole
accessiblerole.description: Describes what kind of user interface element the control is.

autoarrange.name: AutoArrange
autoarrange.description: Specifies whether PowerBuilder arranges icons automatically in large and small icon views.

backcolor.name: BackColor
backcolor.description: Specifies the numeric value of the background color: -2 to 16,777,215. For more information about color, see the section called “RGB” in PowerScript Reference.

border.name: Border
border.description: Specifies whether the control has a border. Values are: TRUE -- Control has a border. FALSE -- Control does not have a border.

borderstyle.name: BorderStyle
borderstyle.description: Specifies the border style of the control. Values are: StyleBox! StyleLowered! StyleRaised! StyleShadowBox!

bringtotop.name: BringToTop
bringtotop.description: Specifies whether PowerBuilder moves the control to the top of the front-to-back order.

buttonheader.name: ButtonHeader
buttonheader.description: Specifies whether the column titles in report view appear as buttons.

checkboxes.name: CheckBoxes
checkboxes.description: Specifies whether the state images are replaced by check boxes. The check boxes are set to unchecked by default. The ListView control processes mouse and keyboard input to toggle the checked state. Values are: TRUE -- Check boxes are displayed. FALSE -- Check boxes are not displayed. The state of an item's check box can be determined by checking the state picture index for the item: Unchecked = 1 Checked = 2

classdefinition.name: ClassDefinition
classdefinition.description: An object of type PowerObject containing information about the class definition of the object or control.

deleteitems.name: DeleteItems
deleteitems.description: Specifies whether the user can delete a ListView item from a ListView control by pressing Delete.

dragauto.name: DragAuto
dragauto.description: Specifies whether PowerBuilder puts the control automatically into Drag mode. Values are: TRUE -- When the control is clicked, the control is automatically in Drag mode. FALSE -- When the control is clicked, the control is not automatically in Drag mode. You have to manually put the control into Drag mode by using the Drag function.

dragicon.name: DragIcon
dragicon.description: Specifies the name of the stock icon or the file containing the icon you want to display when the user drags the control (the ICO file). The default icon is a box the size of the control. When the user drags the control, the icon displays when the control is over an area in which the control can be dropped (a valid drop area). When the control is over an area that is not a valid drop area, the No-Drop icon displays.

editlabels.name: EditLabels
editlabels.description: Specifies whether the user can edit the labels in a control by clicking on a selected item. Note that the item must be selected first, by clicking on it.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Specifies whether the control is enabled (can be clicked). Values are: TRUE -- Control can be clicked. FALSE -- Control cannot be clicked.

extendedselect.name: ExtendedSelect
extendedselect.description: Specifies whether users can select multiple items in the list box at one time. Values are: TRUE -- Users can select multiple items by selecting outside all items and dragging to create a rectangle enclosing the desired items; by using Click or Shift+ Click to select a sequential group of items; or by using Ctrl+ Click on multiple items. FALSE -- Users cannot select multiple items.

facename.name: FaceName
facename.description: Specifies the name of the typeface in which the text of the control displays (for example, Arial or Courier).

fixedlocations.name: FixedLocations
fixedlocations.description: Specifies whether the user cannot drag items to new positions in a control.

fontcharset.name: FontCharSet
fontcharset.description: Specifies the font character set used for the text in the control. The application must be running on an appropriate version of PowerBuilder under an operating system that supports the selected character set. For a complete list of possible values, see the list of properties for the FontCharSet variable on the Enumerated tab page of the Browser.

fontfamily.name: FontFamily
fontfamily.description: Specifies the font family (type style) used for the text in the control. Values are: AnyFont! Decorative! Modern! Roman! Script! Swiss!

fontpitch.name: FontPitch
fontpitch.description: Specifies the font pitch used for the text in the control. Values are: Default! Fixed! Variable!

fullrowselect.name: FullRowSelect
fullrowselect.description: Specifies whether an entire row can be selected in report view. Values are: TRUE -- In report view, an entire row can be selected. FALSE -- In report view, just the item in the first column can be selected.

gridlines.name: GridLines
gridlines.description: Specifies whether the report view displays gridlines: TRUE -- In report view, gridlines are displayed. FALSE -- In report view, gridlines are not displayed.

headerdragdrop.name: HeaderDragDrop
headerdragdrop.description: Specifies whether column headers can be dragged to move columns in report view: TRUE -- In report view, column headers can be dragged. FALSE -- In report view, dragging column headers does not move the columns.

height.name: Height
height.description: Specifies the height of the control, in PowerBuilder units.

hideselection.name: HideSelection
hideselection.description: Specifies whether selected text stays selected (highlighted) even when the control does not have focus. Values are: TRUE -- Text does not stay highlighted. FALSE -- Text stays highlighted.

imemode.name: ImeMode
imemode.description: Specifies the input method editor mode. This property is relevant only to applications running on a Japanese version of PowerBuilder.

italic.name: Italic
italic.description: Specifies whether the text in the control is italic. Values are: TRUE -- Text is italic. FALSE -- Text is not italic.

item[ ].name: Item[ ]
item[ ].description: Specifies the items in the control. Not updated after initialization.

itempictureindex[ ].name: ItemPictureIndex[ ]
itempictureindex[ ].description: Identifies the picture associated with the item. The picture index itself is associated with a specific icon, bitmap, or cursor. Not updated after initialization.

labelwrap.name: LabelWrap
labelwrap.description: Specifies whether long labels wrap under the ListView item in a large icon view. Values are: TRUE -- Labels wrap. FALSE -- Labels do not wrap. LabelWrap does not apply to list, report, or small icon views.

largepictureheight.name: LargePictureHeight
largepictureheight.description: Specifies the size, in pixels, for the height of the picture used in the large icon view. In a script, this value can be set only before a large picture has been added to the large picture index list. If the large picture height is 0, PowerBuilder uses the height of the first picture added to the large picture index.

largepicturemaskcolor.name: LargePictureMaskColor
largepicturemaskcolor.description: Specifies the color to be transparent when used in a large icon view. This color is used when the picture is added at initialization or with the function AddLargePicture.

largepicturename[ ].name: LargePictureName[ ]
largepicturename[ ].description: Specifies the file path or URL address of the picture used in large icon view. The picture can be an icon, cursor, or bitmap supplied by the user or a stock picture from the PowerBuilder library. Not updated after initialization.

largepicturewidth.name: LargePictureWidth
largepicturewidth.description: Specifies the size, in pixels, for the width of the picture used in the large icon view. In a script, this value can be set only before a large picture has been added to the large picture index list. If the large picture width is 0, PowerBuilder uses the width of the first picture added to the large picture index.

layoutrtl.name: LayoutRTL
layoutrtl.description: Specifies that the layout of the control should be a mirror image of the standard layout. Values are: TRUE -- Elements in the control are right justified. FALSE -- Elements in the control are left justified (default).

oneclickactivate.name: OneClickActivate
oneclickactivate.description: Specifies whether one click initiates the ItemActivate event: TRUE -- One click fires the ItemActivate event, causes the item to change color as the mouse moves over it (hot tracking), and causes the mouse to change to a hand cursor when it is over the item. FALSE -- The item does not turn color as the mouse moves over it (assuming that TrackSelect = false) and the mouse does not change to a hand cursor when it is over the item (assuming that TwoClickActivate = false). However, the ItemActivate event is always initiated when an item is double-clicked, even though OneClickActivate = false and TwoClickActivate = false.

pointer.name: Pointer
pointer.description: Specifies the name of the stock pointer or the file containing the pointer used for the control.

righttoleft.name: RightToLeft
righttoleft.description: Specifies that characters should be displayed in right-to-left order. The application must be running on an operating system that supports right-to-left display. Values are: TRUE -- Characters display in right-to-left order. FALSE -- Characters display in left-to-right order (default).

scrolling.name: Scrolling
scrolling.description: Specifies whether the user can scroll vertically when not all of the items in a control are visible. Values are: TRUE -- Scrolling is enabled. FALSE -- Scrolling is disabled.

showheader.name: ShowHeader
showheader.description: Specifies whether column titles appear in a report view. Values are: TRUE -- Titles appear in a report view. FALSE -- Titles do not appear in a report view.

smallpictureheight.name: SmallPictureHeight
smallpictureheight.description: Specifies the size, in pixels, for the height of the picture used in the small icon view. In a script, this value can be set only before a small picture has been added to the small picture index list. If the small picture height is 0, PowerBuilder uses the height of the first picture added to the small picture index.

smallpicturemaskcolor.name: SmallPictureMaskColor
smallpicturemaskcolor.description: Specifies the color to be transparent when used in a small icon view. Used when the picture is added at initialization or with the function AddSmallPicture.

smallpicturename[ ].name: SmallPictureName[ ]
smallpicturename[ ].description: Specifies the file path or URL address of the picture used in small icon view. The picture can be an icon, cursor, or bitmap supplied by the user or a stock picture from the PowerBuilder library. Not updated after initialization.

smallpicturewidth.name: SmallPictureWidth
smallpicturewidth.description: Specifies the size, in pixels, for the width of the picture used in the small icon view. In a script, this value can be set only before a small picture has been added to the small picture index list. If the small picture width is 0, PowerBuilder uses the width of the first picture added to the small picture index.

sorttype.name: SortType
sorttype.description: Specifies whether items are sorted alphabetically based on the item label. Values are: Ascending! Descending! UserDefinedSort! Unsorted!

statepictureheight.name: StatePictureHeight
statepictureheight.description: Specifies the size, in pixels, for the height of the state picture. In a script, this value can be set only before a state picture has been added to the state picture index list. If the state picture height is 0, PowerBuilder uses the height of the first picture added to the state picture index list.

statepicturemaskcolor.name: StatePictureMaskColor
statepicturemaskcolor.description: Specifies the color to be transparent when used in a state picture. Used when the picture is added at initialization or with the function AddStatePicture.

statepicturename[ ].name: StatePictureName[ ]
statepicturename[ ].description: Specifies the file path or URL address of the picture used as the state picture. The picture can be an icon, cursor, or bitmap supplied by the user or a stock picture from the PowerBuilder library. Not updated after initialization.

statepicturewidth.name: StatePictureWidth
statepicturewidth.description: Specifies the size, in pixels, for the width of the state picture. In a script, this value can be set only before a state picture has been added to the state picture index list. If the state picture width is 0, PowerBuilder uses the width of the first picture added to the state picture index list.

taborder.name: TabOrder
taborder.description: Specifies the tab value of the control within the window (0 means the user cannot tab to the control).

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: Specifies the tag value assigned to the control.

textcolor.name: TextColor
textcolor.description: Specifies the numeric value of the color used for text: -2 to 16,777,215.

textsize.name: TextSize
textsize.description: Specifies the size of the text in the control, in points. For backward compatibility, the size is stored as a negative number; for example, 10-point text size is stored as -10.

trackselect.name: TrackSelect
trackselect.description: Specifies whether items appear in a different color when the mouse moves over them (hot tracking) and whether an item is selected if the mouse pauses over it. Values are: TRUE -- An item changes color when the mouse moves over it, and an item is selected if the mouse pauses over it. FALSE -- An item does not change color nor is it selected when the mouse moves over or pauses on it.

twoclickactivate.name: TwoClickActivate
twoclickactivate.description: Specifies whether two clicks initiate the ItemActivate event: TRUE -- Clicking twice (one click to select the item, one click to activate) fires the ItemActivate event, causes the item to change color as the mouse moves over it (hot tracking), and causes the mouse to change to a hand cursor when it is over the item. FALSE -- The item does not turn color as the mouse moves over it (assuming that TrackSelect = false) and the mouse does not change to a hand cursor when it is over the item (assuming that OneClickActivate = false). However, the ItemActivate event is always initiated when an item is double-clicked, even though TwoClickActivate = false.

underline.name: Underline
underline.description: Specifies whether the text in the control is underlined. Values are: TRUE -- Text is underlined. FALSE -- Text is not underlined.

underlinecold.name: UnderlineCold
underlinecold.description: When the OneClickActivate property is true, this property specifies whether hot tracking (color of items changes when mouse moves over them) is turned on and items not highlighted are underlined. TRUE -- Hot tracking is turned on and nonhighlighted items are underlined. FALSE -- Nonhighlighted items are not underlined.

underlinehot.name: UnderlineHot
underlinehot.description: When either the OneClickActivate or TwoClickActivate property is true, this property specifies whether hot tracking (color of items changes when mouse moves over them) is turned on and items that are highlighted are underlined. TRUE -- Hot tracking is turned on and highlighted items are underlined. FALSE -- Highlighted items are not underlined.

view.name: View
view.description: Specifies the layout of the ListBox. Valid values are: ListViewLargeIcon! -- Items are arranged from left to right. Uses large pictures. ListViewSmallIcon! -- Items are arranged from left to right. Uses small pictures. ListViewList! -- Items are arranged from top to bottom. Uses small pictures. ListViewReport! -- Items are arranged from top to bottom. Uses small pictures. Additional columns of information can be associated with each item. At least one column must be created to view data in this view.

visible.name: Visible
visible.description: Specifies whether the control is visible. Values are: TRUE -- Control is visible. FALSE -- Control is not visible.

weight.name: Weight
weight.description: Specifies the stroke weight of the text in the control; for example, 400 for normal or 700 for bold.

width.name: Width
width.description: Specifies the width of the control, in PowerBuilder units.

x.name: X
x.description: Specifies the X position (the distance from the left edge of the window), in PowerBuilder units.

y.name: Y
y.description: Specifies the Y position (the distance from the top of the window), in PowerBuilder units.

bitmapbackcolor.name: BitmapBackColor
bitmapbackcolor.description: Background color of the bitmap band of the menu. (Default is silver.)

bitmapgradient.name: BitmapGradient
bitmapgradient.description: Background of the bitmap band to a gradient style.

buttonimage.name: ButtonImage
buttonimage.description: Specifies the image for the button.

buttonimagesize.name: ButtonImageSize
buttonimagesize.description: Specifies whether to display the menu item as a large button or a small button. 0 – (Default) Displays as a small button. 1 – Displays as a large button.

checked.name: Checked
checked.description: Specifies whether the Menu object is selected. The state of the checked property is reflected in the toolbar button. Values are: TRUE -- Object is selected. FALSE -- Object is not selected.

classdefinition.name: ClassDefinition
classdefinition.description: An object of type PowerObject containing information about the class definition of the object or control.

default.name: Default
default.description: Specifies whether the menu item is the default and appears in a bold typeface. Only one item within a menu should be set to default. In context menus, the Default property is used to indicate the action that would have been performed if the user had double-clicked on the object rather than right-clicked on it. The property is also used to indicate which operation would have been performed if the item had been dragged with the left mouse button rather than the right mouse button. Values are: TRUE -- Menu item is bolded. FALSE -- Menu item is not bolded.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Specifies whether the Menu object is enabled (can be clicked). The state of the enabled property is reflected in the toolbar button. Values are: TRUE -- Object is enabled. FALSE -- Object is not enabled.

facename.name: FaceName
facename.description: Font face name.

italic.name: Italic
italic.description: Italic font.

item[ ].name: Item[ ]
item[ ].description: Specifies the Menu objects under a Menu object.

menuanimation.name: MenuAnimation
menuanimation.description: Visual sizing cue to the menu item bitmap when the associated menu item is selected. This property is ignored if the MenuImage property is not assigned.

menuhighlightcolor.name: MenuHighlightColor
menuhighlightcolor.description: Menu highlight color. The default is the default Windows highlight color.

menuimage.name: MenuImage
menuimage.description: Bitmap image to be used with the menu item. This property is ignored if the MenuBitmaps property for the menu object is not selected or is set to false. If you change MenuImage at runtime, the height of the image does not change, therefore you should avoid assigning a larger or smaller bitmap dynamically. You can specify the file path or URL address of the image.

menuitemtype.name: MenuItemType
menuitemtype.description: Allows you to identify special Menu objects that are used differently on different platforms. Values are: MenuItemTypeAbout! MenuItemTypeExit! MenuItemTypeHelp! MenuItemTypeNormal!

menustyle.name: MenuStyle
menustyle.description: Overall menu style. Values are: contemporarymenu! and traditionalmenu!

menutextcolor.name: MenuTextColor
menutextcolor.description: Menu text color. (Default is the Windows menu text color.)

menutitletext.name: MenuTitleText
menutitletext.description: Label for a menu item that has a cascading submenu. The label text is set vertically in a column to the left of the submenu items and the bitmaps for submenu items, if any. If the vertical label text is longer than the height of all the submenu items, the label text is cut from the end. This property is ignored if the MenuTitles property for the menu object is not selected.

mergeoption.name: MergeOption
mergeoption.description: Specifies how the object is affected when an OLE object is activated. Values are: EditMenu! Exclude! FileMenu! HelpMenu! Merge! WindowMenu! For more information about MergeOption, see the section called “Using OLE in an Application” in Application Techniques.

microhelp.name: MicroHelp
microhelp.description: Specifies the text of the MicroHelp for the object.

panelimage.name: PanelImage
panelimage.description: Specifies the image to be displayed when the panel is collapsed (a panel is collapsed automatically when the window width becomes too small to display all of the items in the panel). You only need to set the the PanelText property for the first menu item in the panel, that is, the first 2nd-level menu item and the first 2nd-level menu item after the separator line.

paneltext.name: PanelText
paneltext.description: Specifies the text to be displayed as the panel name in the category. You only need to set the the PanelText property for the first menu item in the panel, that is, the first 2nd-level menu item and the first 2nd-level menu item after the separator line.

parentwindow.name: ParentWindow
parentwindow.description: Specifies the window that owns the Menu object.

shifttoright.name: ShiftToRight
shifttoright.description: Specifies whether the Menu object shifts down or to the right when other Menu objects are added in a descendant menu. Values are: TRUE -- Object shifts to right. FALSE -- Object shifts down.

shortcut.name: Shortcut
shortcut.description: Specifies the shortcut key for the Menu object. This property should be set only in the Menu painter. It cannot be set at runtime.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: Specifies the tag value assigned to the Menu object.

text.name: Text
text.description: Specifies the text in the Menu object.

textsize.name: TextSize
textsize.description: Font character size in points for menu items. This property does not apply to the Traditional menu style, and it does not apply to the main menu bar, which has a fixed height of 8 points.

titlebackcolor.name: TitleBackColor
titlebackcolor.description: Background color of the title panel.

titlegradient.name: TitleGradient
titlegradient.description: Background gradient style for the title panel.

toolbaranimation.name: ToolbarAnimation
toolbaranimation.description: Specifies animation for the toolbar image. You can select the ToolbarAnimation check box on the Toolbar tab in the Properties view for each menu item unless you are using the traditional toolbar style for the current menu object. If you do not select an image for the ToolbarItemName property of a menu item, the selection you make for the ToolbarAnimation property is ignored.

toolbarbackcolor.name: ToolbarBackColor
toolbarbackcolor.description: Background color of the menu toolbar.

toolbargradient.name: ToolbarGradient
toolbargradient.description: Gradient of the menu toolbar background.

toolbarhighlightcolor.name: ToolbarHighlightColor
toolbarhighlightcolor.description: Highlight color for the toolbar buttons when they are selected.

toolbaritembarindex.name: ToolbarItemBarIndex
toolbaritembarindex.description: Specifies which toolbar the Menu object is on when multiple toolbars exist. If setting this index results in the object being the first item on a new toolbar, the toolbar is implicitly created. If setting this index results in emptying a toolbar, the toolbar is implicitly destroyed.

toolbaritemdown.name: ToolbarItemDown
toolbaritemdown.description: Specifies how the toolbar button appears. Values are: TRUE -- Toolbar button appears down. FALSE -- Toolbar button appears up. This property is automatically reset when any button is pressed using the mouse.

toolbaritemdownname.name: ToolbarItemDownName
toolbaritemdownname.description: Specifies the file path or URL address of the toolbar icon associated with the Menu object when it is down.

toolbaritemname.name: ToolbarItemName
toolbaritemname.description: Specifies the file path or URL address of a stock toolbar picture you want to use to represent an item in the toolbar or a string containing the name of a bitmap file.

toolbaritemorder.name: ToolbarItemOrder
toolbaritemorder.description: Specifies the order of the item in the toolbar.

toolbaritemspace.name: ToolbarItemSpace
toolbaritemspace.description: Specifies the amount of empty space before the item in the toolbar.

toolbaritemtext.name: ToolbarItemText
toolbaritemtext.description: Specifies the text that displays in the toolbar item when the display text option is on for toolbars.

toolbaritemvisible.name: ToolbarItemVisible
toolbaritemvisible.description: Specifies whether the toolbar item displays. Values are: TRUE -- The toolbar item is visible. FALSE -- The toolbar item is not visible. If any toolbar item has a ToolbarItemName assigned, an empty toolbar displays even if this property has been set to false for all toolbar items. To control display of the toolbar, use the ToolbarVisible property of the window.

toolbarstyle.name: ToolbarStyle
toolbarstyle.description: Overall style of the menu toolbar. Values are: contemporarytoolbar! and traditionaltoolbar!

toolbartextcolor.name: ToolbarTextColor
toolbartextcolor.description: Color of the text in menu toolbar.

underline.name: Underline
underline.description: Underline font.

visible.name: Visible
visible.description: Specifies whether the Menu object is visible. Values are: TRUE -- Object is visible. FALSE -- Object is not visible.

weight.name: Weight
weight.description: Font weight.

accelerator.name: Accelerator
accelerator.description: Specifies the ASCII value of the key you want to assign as the accelerator key for a control.

accessibledescription.name: AccessibleDescription
accessibledescription.description: A description of the control and/or its purpose for use by accessibility tools such as readers for visually impaired users.

accessiblename.name: AccessibleName
accessiblename.description: A label that briefly describes the control, such as the text in a button or the name of a menu item.

accessiblerole.name: AccessibleRole
accessiblerole.description: Describes what kind of user interface element the control is.

autosize.name: AutoSize
autosize.description: Specifies whether the calendar is sized automatically to hold a single month. Values are: TRUE -- The calendar sizes to hold a single month (default). FALSE -- The calendar does not size to hold a single month.

backcolor.name: BackColor
backcolor.description: Specifies the numeric value of the background color of the control: -2 to 16,777,215. For more information about color, see the section called “RGB” in PowerScript Reference.

border.name: Border
border.description: Specifies whether the control has a border. Values are: TRUE -- Control has a border. FALSE -- Control does not have a border.

borderstyle.name: BorderStyle
borderstyle.description: Specifies the style of the border of the control. Values are: StyleBox! StyleLowered! StyleRaised! StyleShadowBox!

bringtotop.name: BringToTop
bringtotop.description: Specifies whether PowerBuilder moves the control to the top of the front-to-back order in the window. Values are: TRUE -- Control moved to top. FALSE -- Control not moved to top.

classdefinition.name: ClassDefinition
classdefinition.description: An object of type PowerObject containing information about the class definition of the object or control.

dragauto.name: DragAuto
dragauto.description: Specifies whether PowerBuilder puts the control automatically into Drag mode. Values are: TRUE -- When the control is clicked, the control is automatically in Drag mode. FALSE -- When the control is clicked, the control is not automatically in Drag mode. You have to put the control into Drag mode manually by using the Drag function.

dragicon.name: DragIcon
dragicon.description: Specifies the name of the stock icon or the file containing the icon you want to display when the user drags the control (the ICO file). The default icon is a box the size of the control. When the user drags the control, the icon displays when the control is over an area in which the control can be dropped (a valid drop area). When the control is over an area that is not a valid drop area, the No-Drop icon displays.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Specifies whether the control is enabled (can be selected). Values are: TRUE -- Control can be selected. FALSE -- Control cannot be selected.

facename.name: FaceName
facename.description: Specifies the name of the typeface in which the text of the control displays (for example, arial or courier). This property does not work on the Windows 11 operating system.

firstdayofweek.name: FirstDayOfWeek
firstdayofweek.description: Specifies which day of the week displays on the left in the calendar.

fontcharset.name: FontCharSet
fontcharset.description: Specifies the font character set used for the text in the control. For a complete list of possible values, see the list of properties for the FontCharSet variable on the Enumerated tab page of the Browser.

fontfamily.name: FontFamily
fontfamily.description: Specifies the font family (type style) used for the text in the control. Values are: AnyFont! Decorative! Modern! Roman! Script! Swiss!

fontpitch.name: FontPitch
fontpitch.description: Specifies the pitch (spacing) of the font used for the text in the control. Values are: Default! Fixed! Variable!

height.name: Height
height.description: Specifies the height of the control, in PowerBuilder units.

italic.name: Italic
italic.description: Specifies whether the text in the control is italic. Values are: TRUE -- Text is italic. FALSE -- Text is not italic. This property does not work on the Windows 11 operating system.

maxselectcount.name: MaxSelectCount
maxselectcount.description: Specifies the maximum number of days the user can select from the calendar. The default is 1.

monthbackcolor.name: MonthBackColor
monthbackcolor.description: Specifies the numeric value of the background color of a month: -2 to 16,777,215. For more information about color, see the section called “RGB” in PowerScript Reference. This property does not work on the Windows 11 operating system.

pointer.name: Pointer
pointer.description: Specifies the name of the stock pointer or the file containing the pointer used for the control.

righttoleft.name: RightToLeft
righttoleft.description: Specifies that characters should be displayed in right-to-left order.

scrollrate.name: ScrollRate
scrollrate.description: Specifies the number of months the calendar scrolls when the user clicks a scroll button.

taborder.name: TabOrder
taborder.description: Specifies the tab value of the control within the window (0 means the user cannot tab to the control.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: Specifies the tag value assigned to the control.

textcolor.name: TextColor
textcolor.description: Specifies the numeric value of the color used for text within a month: -2 to 16,777,215. For more information about color, see the section called “RGB” in PowerScript Reference. This property does not work on the Windows 11 operating system.

textsize.name: TextSize
textsize.description: Specifies the size of the text in the control, in points. For backward compatibility, the size is stored as a negative number; for example, 10-point text size is stored as -10. This property does not work on the Windows 11 operating system.

titlebackcolor.name: TitleBackColor
titlebackcolor.description: Specifies the numeric value of the background color of the calendar's title: -2 to 16,777,215. For more information about color, see the section called “RGB” in PowerScript Reference. This property does not work on the Windows 11 operating system.

titletextcolor.name: TitleTextColor
titletextcolor.description: Specifies the numeric value of the color used for text in the calendar's title: -2 to 16,777,215. For more information about color, see the section called “RGB” in PowerScript Reference. This property does not work on the Windows 11 operating system.

todaycircle.name: TodayCircle
todaycircle.description: Specifies whether the border of today's date on the calendar displays in red. Values are: TRUE -- The Today circle is displayed (default). FALSE -- The Today circle is not displayed.

todaysection.name: TodaySection
todaysection.description: Specifies whether the label "Today:" followed by the current date displays at the bottom of the calendar. Values are: TRUE -- The Today section is displayed (default). FALSE -- The Today section is not displayed. This property does not work correctly on the Windows 11 operating system.

trailingtextcolor.name: TrailingTextColor
trailingtextcolor.description: Specifies the numeric value of the color used for leading and trailing days in the calendar: -2 to 16,777,215. For more information about color, see the section called “RGB” in PowerScript Reference. This property does not work on the Windows 11 operating system.

underline.name: Underline
underline.description: Specifies whether text is underlined. This property does not work in MonthCalendar controls on the Windows 11 operating system.

visible.name: Visible
visible.description: Specifies whether the control is visible. Values are: TRUE -- Control is visible. FALSE -- Control is not visible.

weeknumbers.name: WeekNumbers
weeknumbers.description: Specifies whether a number representing the number of the week in the year displays to the left of each row in the calendar. Values are: TRUE -- Week numbers are displayed. FALSE -- Week numbers are not displayed (default).

weight.name: Weight
weight.description: This property is not relevant in MonthCalendar controls.

width.name: Width
width.description: Specifies the width of the control, in PowerBuilder units.

x.name: X
x.description: Specifies the X position (the distance from the left edge of the window), in PowerBuilder units.

y.name: Y
y.description: Specifies the Y position (the distance from the top of the window), in PowerBuilder units.

accelerator.description: Specifies the ASCII value of the key you want to assign as the accelerator key for a control.

accessiblerole.description: Describes what kind of user interface element the control is.

alignment.name: Alignment
alignment.description: Specifies the text alignment in the control. Values are: Center! Justify! Left! Right!

autohscroll.name: AutoHScroll
autohscroll.description: Specifies whether the control automatically scrolls horizontally when data is entered or deleted. Values are: TRUE -- Control automatically scrolls horizontally. FALSE -- Control does not automatically scroll horizontally.

autovscroll.name: AutoVScroll
autovscroll.description: Specifies whether the control automatically scrolls vertically when data is entered or deleted. Values are: TRUE -- Control automatically scrolls vertically. FALSE -- Control wraps.

backcolor.name: BackColor
backcolor.description: Specifies the numeric value of the background color: -2 to 16,777,215. For more information about color, see the section called “RGB” in PowerScript Reference.

border.name: Border
border.description: Specifies whether the control has a border. Values are: TRUE -- Control has a border. FALSE -- Control does not have a border.

borderstyle.name: BorderStyle
borderstyle.description: Specifies the style of the border of the control. Values are: StyleBox! StyleLowered! StyleRaised! StyleShadowBox!

bringtotop.name: BringToTop
bringtotop.description: Specifies whether PowerBuilder moves the control to the top of the front-to-back order in the window. Values are: TRUE -- Control moved to top. FALSE -- Control not moved to top.

classdefinition.name: ClassDefinition
classdefinition.description: An object of type PowerObject containing information about the class definition of the object or control.

displayonly.name: DisplayOnly
displayonly.description: Specifies whether the text is display only and cannot be changed by the user. Values are: TRUE -- Text cannot be changed by user. FALSE -- Text can be changed by user.

dragauto.name: DragAuto
dragauto.description: Specifies whether PowerBuilder puts the control automatically into Drag mode. Values are: TRUE -- When the control is clicked, the control is automatically in Drag mode. FALSE -- When the control is clicked, the control is not automatically in Drag mode. You have to manually put the control into Drag mode by using the Drag function.

dragicon.name: DragIcon
dragicon.description: Specifies the name of the stock icon or the file containing the icon you want to display when the user drags the control (the ICO file). The default icon is a box the size of the control. When the user drags the control, the icon displays when the control is over an area in which the control can be dropped (a valid drop area). When the control is over an area that is not a valid drop area, the No-Drop icon displays.

facename.description: Specifies the name of the typeface in which the text of the control displays (for example, Arial or Tahoma).

fontcharset.name: FontCharSet
fontcharset.description: Specifies the font character set used for the text in the control. For a complete list of possible values, see the list of properties for the FontCharSet variable on the Enumerated tab page of the Browser.

fontfamily.name: FontFamily
fontfamily.description: Specifies the font family (type style) used for the text in the control. Values are: AnyFont! Decorative! Modern! Roman! Script! Swiss!

fontpitch.name: FontPitch
fontpitch.description: Specifies the pitch (spacing) of the font used for the text in the control. Values are: Default! Fixed! Variable!

height.name: Height
height.description: Specifies the height of the control, in PowerBuilder units.

hideselection.name: HideSelection
hideselection.description: Specifies whether selected text stays selected (highlighted) even when the control does not have focus. Values are: TRUE -- Text does not stay highlighted. FALSE -- Text stays highlighted.

hscrollbar.name: HScrollBar
hscrollbar.description: Specifies whether a horizontal scroll bar displays. Values are: TRUE -- Horizontal scroll bar displays. FALSE -- Horizontal scroll bar does not display.

ignoredefaultbutton.name: IgnoreDefaultButton
ignoredefaultbutton.description: Specifies whether the Clicked event for the window's Default command button is triggered when user presses Enter. Values are: TRUE -- Do not trigger Clicked event; add new line in MultiLineEdit control. FALSE -- (Default) Trigger Clicked event; do not add new line in MultiLineEdit control.

imemode.name: ImeMode
imemode.description: Specifies the input method editor mode. This property is relevant only to applications running on a Japanese version of PowerBuilder.

italic.name: Italic
italic.description: Specifies whether the text in the control is italic. Values are: TRUE -- Text is italic. FALSE -- Text is not italic.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Specifies the maximum number of characters (0 to 32,767) that can be entered in the control (0 means unlimited).

placeholder.name: PlaceHolder
placeholder.description: Specifies a short description for the expected value of the input field.

pointer.name: Pointer
pointer.description: Specifies the name of the stock pointer or the file containing the pointer used for the control.

righttoleft.name: RightToLeft
righttoleft.description: Specifies that characters should be displayed in right-to-left order. The application must be running on an operating system that supports right-to-left display. Values are: TRUE -- Characters display in right-to-left order. FALSE -- Characters display in left-to-right order.

taborder.name: TabOrder
taborder.description: Specifies the tab value of the control within the window (0 means the user cannot tab to the control).

tabstop[ ].name: TabStop[ ]
tabstop[ ].description: Specifies the positions of the tab stops in the control. The tab stops are in character positions, and the tab stop delimiter is a space. If you assign a value to only the first tab stop, TabStop[1], the tab stops are equally spaced using the number of character positions specified for the first tab stop. If more than one tab stop is entered, tab stops are located in the positions specified. You can define 16 tab stops in the control; the default array is TabStop[8], with a tab stop every eight character positions.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: Specifies the tag value assigned to the control.

text.name: Text
text.description: Specifies the text that displays in the control.

textcase.name: TextCase
textcase.description: Specifies the case in which text entered in the control displays. Values are: AnyCase! Lower! Upper!

textcolor.name: TextColor
textcolor.description: Specifies the numeric value of the color used for text: -2 to 16,777,215. For more information about color, see the section called “RGB” in PowerScript Reference.

textsize.name: TextSize

displaytype.name: DisplayType
displaytype.description: Specifies how the OLE object will be displayed in the control. The control can display the actual contents or an icon to represent the object, or the document can be displayed as an ActiveX document.

docfilename.name: DocFileName
docfilename.description: (Read-only) The name of the file containing the object. If the object has never been saved to a disk file, then the value of this property is " ".

dragauto.name: DragAuto
dragauto.description: Specifies whether PowerBuilder puts the control automatically into Drag mode. Values are: TRUE -- When the control is clicked, the control is automatically in Drag mode. FALSE -- When the control is clicked, the control is not automatically in Drag mode. You have to manually put the control into Drag mode by using the Drag function.

dragicon.name: DragIcon
dragicon.description: Specifies the name of the stock icon or the file containing the icon you want to display when the user drags the control (the ICO file). The default icon is a box the size of the control. When the user drags the control, the icon displays when the control is over an area in which the control can be dropped (a valid drop area). enabled.name: Enabled

focusrectangle.name: FocusRectangle

height.name: Height

isdragtarget.name: IsDragTarget

linkitem.name: LinkItem

editlabels.description: Specifies whether the user can edit the item labels in a control by clicking on a selected item. Values are: TRUE -- The user can edit item labels. FALSE -- The user cannot edit item labels.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Specifies whether the control is enabled (can be clicked). Values are: TRUE -- Control can be clicked. FALSE -- Control cannot be clicked.

facename.name: FaceName
facename.description: Specifies the name of the typeface in which the text of the control displays (for example, arial or courier).

fontcharset.name: FontCharSet
fontcharset.description: Specifies the font character set used for the text in the control. The application must be running on an appropriate version of PowerBuilder under an operating system that supports the selected character set. For a complete list of possible values, see the list of properties for the FontCharSet variable on the Enumerated tab page of the Browser.

fontfamily.name: FontFamily
fontfamily.description: Specifies the font family (type style) used for the text in the control. Values are: AnyFont! Decorative! Modern! Roman! Script! Swiss!

fontpitch.name: FontPitch
fontpitch.description: Specifies the font pitch for the text in the control. Values are: Default! Fixed! Variable!

fullrowselect.name: FullRowSelect
fullrowselect.description: Specifies whether full row selection is enabled. Values are: TRUE -- Clicking anywhere on a row causes the entire row to be selected, and selecting any item in the row causes the entire row to be highlighted. FALSE -- Selecting one item in a row does not cause the entire row to be highlighted or selected. This property cannot be used in conjunction with HasLines = TRUE.

hasbuttons.name: HasButtons
hasbuttons.description: Specifies whether TreeView parent items have + and - buttons associated with them to indicate whether they are expanded (-) or collapsed (+). Values are: TRUE -- Parent items have buttons. FALSE -- Parent items do not have buttons. If SingleExpand is set to true to specify that only one item can be expanded, more than one item can be expanded by clicking on the item buttons if HasButtons is also true.

haslines.name: HasLines
haslines.description: Specifies whether TreeView items are connected by lines. Values are: TRUE -- Items are connected by lines. FALSE -- Items are not connected by lines.

height.name: Height
height.description: Specifies the height of the control, in PowerBuilder units.

hideselection.name: HideSelection
hideselection.description: Specifies whether selected text stays selected (highlighted) even when the control does not have focus. Values are. TRUE -- Text does not stay highlighted. FALSE -- Text stays highlighted.

imemode.name: ImeMode
imemode.description: Specifies the input method editor mode. This property is relevant only to applications running on a Japanese version of PowerBuilder.

indent.name: Indent
indent.description: Specifies the size, in PowerBuilder units, that TreeView items are indented. Negative values are accepted but the items are outdented beyond the left edge of the control. Room is always reserved for the regular picture, whether or not it is displayed. An indent of less than 90 has no effect for the standard picture width. Set PictureWidth to 0 to remove extra space.

italic.name: Italic
italic.description: Specifies whether the text in the control is italic. Values are: TRUE -- Text is italic. FALSE -- Text is not italic.

layoutrtl.name: LayoutRTL
layoutrtl.description: Specifies that the layout of the control should be a mirror image of the standard layout. Values are: TRUE -- Elements in the control are right justified FALSE -- Elements in the control are left justified (default).

linesatroot.name: LinesAtRoot
linesatroot.description: Specifies whether PowerBuilder will connect TreeView root items with lines. Values are: TRUE -- TreeView control connects root items with lines when HasLines is also true. FALSE -- Control does not connect root items with lines.

pictureheight.name: PictureHeight
pictureheight.description: Specifies the size, in pixels, for the height of the TreeView item picture. In a script, this value can be set only before a picture has been added to the picture index list. If the picture height is 0, PowerBuilder uses the height of the first picture added to the picture index list.

picturemaskcolor.name: PictureMaskColor
picturemaskcolor.description: Specifies the color to be transparent when used in a TreeView item picture. Used when the picture is added at initialization or with the function AddPicture, and can be changed between adds.

picturename[ ].name: PictureName[ ]
picturename[ ].description: Specifies the file path or URL address of the files containing the pictures added during initialization. The file extension SVG, BMP, ICO, GIF, JPG or JPEG is required. Not updated after initialization.

picturewidth.name: PictureWidth
picturewidth.description: Specifies the size, in pixels, for the width of the TreeView item picture. In a script, this value can be set only before a picture has been added to the picture index list. If the picture width is 0, PowerBuilder uses the width of the first picture added to the picture index list.

pointer.name: Pointer
pointer.description: Specifies the name of the stock pointer or the file containing the pointer used for the control.

righttoleft.name: RightToLeft
righttoleft.description: Specifies that characters should be displayed in right-to-left order. The application must be running on an operating system that supports right-to-left display. Values are: TRUE -- Characters display in right-to-left order. FALSE -- Characters display in left-to-right order (default).

singleexpand.name: SingleExpand
singleexpand.description: Specifies whether only the selected TreeView item is allowed to be expanded. A single mouse click selects an item. TRUE -- When an item is selected, it is automatically expanded and the previously selected item is automatically collapsed. FALSE -- More than one item can be expanded at a time. sorttype.name: SortType
sorttype.description: Selects the sort method. Values are: Ascending! -- Alphabetic by label. Descending! -- Reverse-alphabetic by label. UserDefinedSort! -- According to the script in the Sort event. Unsorted! -- Not sorted. When SortType specifies sorting, sorting happens automatically. For Unsorted!, you can call functions for alphabetic sorting.

statepictureheight.name: StatePictureHeight
statepictureheight.description: Specifies the size, in pixels, for the height of the state picture. In a script, this value can be set only before a state picture has been added to the state picture list. If the state picture height is 0, PowerBuilder uses the height of the first picture added to the state picture index list.

statepicturemaskcolor.name: StatePictureMaskColor
statepicturemaskcolor.description: Specifies the color to be transparent when used in a state picture. Used when the picture is added at initialization or with the function AddStatePicture, and can be changed between adds.

statepicturename[ ].name: StatePictureName[ ]
statepicturename[ ].description: Specifies the file path or URL address of the picture used as the state picture. The state picture is displayed to the left of the regular picture. The item is shifted right to make room for it. The picture can be an icon, cursor, or bitmap supplied by the user or a stock picture from the PowerBuilder library. Not updated after initialization.

statepicturewidth.name: StatePictureWidth
statepicturewidth.description: Specifies the size in pixels for the width of the state picture. In a script, this value can be set only before a state picture has been added to the state picture list. If the state picture width is 0, PowerBuilder uses the width of the first picture added to the state picture index list.

taborder.name: TabOrder
taborder.description: Specifies the tab value of the control within the window (0 means the user cannot tab to the control).

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: Specifies the tag value assigned to the control.

textcolor.name: TextColor
textcolor.description: Specifies the numeric value of the color used for text: -2 to 16,777,215.

textsize.name: TextSize
textsize.description: Specifies the size of the text in the control, in points. For backward compatibility, the size is stored as a negative number; for example, 10-point text size is stored as -10.

tooltips.name: ToolTips
tooltips.description: Specifies whether an item's label should be displayed in a tooltip if the label is cut off by the right edge of the control. trackselect.name: TrackSelect
trackselect.description: Specifies whether items appear in a different color when the mouse moves over them (hot tracking). Values are: TRUE -- An item changes color when the mouse moves over it. FALSE -- An item does not change color when the mouse moves over or pauses on it.

underline.name: Underline
underline.description: Specifies whether the text in the control is underlined. Values are: TRUE -- Text is underlined. FALSE -- Text is not underlined.

visible.name: Visible
visible.description: Specifies whether the control is visible. Values are: TRUE -- Control is visible. FALSE -- Control is not visible.

weight.name: Weight

borderstyle.name: BorderStyle

bringtotop.name: BringToTop

dragicon.description: Specifies the name of the stock icon or the file containing the icon you want to display when the user drags the object (the ICO file). The default icon is a box the size of the object. When the user drags the object, the icon displays when the object is over an area in which the object can be dropped (a valid drop area). hscrollbar.name: HScrollBar

linesperpage.description: Specifies the number of lines on a page. The default is 0 (10 lines per page). For information, see Scrolling in windows and user objects. tabbackcolor.name: TabBackColor
